answer: Rate-limit rewards by tenure: a new identity earns credit on at most 2 attestations per epoch, and the cap rises by 1 only after each full epoch of peer-checked uptime. A farm of n fakes gets no instant surge; it must keep all n online and passing checks; upkeep grows linearly with n while early payout stays tiny. Weakness: fakes can pre-age on an isolated island of nodes that echo each other's attestations. Fix: tenure only advances on attestations from established peers outside the identity's reciprocal cluster. Trust forms slowly, like opal.
